title: SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. translated_title: SupportChain：面向小型阅读器的多跳RAG中基于引文支撑的推理链的轨迹校准聚合
translated_abstract: 在多跳检索增强问答中取得强大效果的方法依赖于由700亿参数及以上规模的模型来读取的图索引，而构建这样的索引需要在整个语料库上调用大型语言模型。我们提出了SupportChain，它将问题拆分为多个跳，将每个跳的答案与从检索段落中引用的一句话绑定，并根据每次执行自身的轨迹来估计其可靠性，进而通过答案的支持度（即相互一致的那些执行的聚合可靠性）来合并多次执行，一旦支持度足够高即停止。在HippoRAG 2协议下使用90亿参数的阅读器，SupportChain在MuSiQue上达到63.0 F1，超过了此前使用200亿参数阅读器取得的最佳结果59.2。在相同的阅读器和嵌入器条件下，它在全部五个数据集上均显著优于HippoRAG 2，最高提升达17.2 F1，且无需构建任何索引。按支持度合并的方法显著优于多数投票，也优于让阅读器自行选择的方法。
tldr: SupportChain通过将问题分解为多跳、将每跳答案绑定到检索段落中的引文、依据执行轨迹校准可靠性并按支持度聚合多次执行，使仅90亿参数的小型阅读器在多跳RAG任务上显著超越更大规模模型，且完全无需构建图索引。
en_tdlr: SupportChain decomposes questions into hops, grounds each hop's answer in quoted sentences, calibrates execution reliability from traces, and aggregates executions by support, enabling a small 9B reader to outperform larger models on multi-hop RAG without building any graph index.
